intro: Explore the planned single and bulk URL workflow. Live Google indexing checks are unavailable.
aboutTitle: How can I verify indexing for a page I manage?
about: Use URL Inspection in Google Search Console for a verified property. This preview cannot check a URL’s live indexing status.
exampleTitle: Check a new article in Search Console
example: Copy the canonical article URL into URL Inspection and read the indexed status for that address.

faqs.question: Does this page provide Google cache dates?
faqs.answer: Cache dates and live index results are unavailable in this preview.
